mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join t_cmp_binding b on b.bnd_user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id > #{afterId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and b.bnd_status=1 order by u.user_id limit 100

select a.app_id as id,p.pos_title as positionName,u.nick_name as candidateName, concat('/enterprise/system-events/applications/',a.app_id) as target from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id=a.app_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=a.app_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where p.pos_company_id=#{companyId} and a.app_created_at >= #{since} and not exists(select 1 from t_msg m where m.msg_receiver_id=#{userId} and m.msg_target_url=concat('/enterprise/system-events/applications/',a.app_id)) order by a.app_created_at,a.app_id limit 50

select a.apt_id as id,p.pos_title as positionName,u.nick_name as candidateName, a.apt_start_time as startTime, concat('/enterprise/system-events/interviews/',a.apt_id,'/upcoming/',date_format(a.apt_start_time,'%Y%m%d%H%i')) as target from t_sch_appointment a join t_pos p on p.pos_id=a.apt_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=a.apt_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where p.pos_company_id=#{companyId} and a.apt_status in (0,1) and a.apt_start_time >= #{now} and a.apt_start_time <= #{until} and not exists(select 1 from t_msg m where m.msg_receiver_id=#{userId} and m.msg_target_url=concat('/enterprise/system-events/interviews/',a.apt_id,'/upcoming/',date_format(a.apt_start_time,'%Y%m%d%H%i'))) order by a.apt_start_time,a.apt_id limit 50

select e.evl_id as id,p.pos_title as positionName,u.nick_name as candidateName, concat('/enterprise/system-events/reports/',e.evl_id) as target from t_int_evaluation e join t_int_session s on s.ses_id=e.evl_session_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id=s.ses_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=s.ses_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where p.pos_company_id=#{companyId} and e.evl_created_at >= #{since} and not exists(select 1 from t_msg m where m.msg_receiver_id=#{userId} and m.msg_target_url=concat('/enterprise/system-events/reports/',e.evl_id)) order by e.evl_created_at,e.evl_id limit 50

select a.apt_id as id,p.pos_title as positionName,u.nick_name as candidateName, case a.apt_status when 1 then '面试安排已确认' when 2 then '面试安排已取消' end as title, concat('/enterprise/system-events/interviews/',a.apt_id,'/status/',a.apt_status) as target from t_sch_appointment a join t_pos p on p.pos_id=a.apt_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=a.apt_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where p.pos_company_id=#{companyId} and a.apt_status in (1,2) and a.apt_updated_at >= #{since} and not exists(select 1 from t_msg m where m.msg_receiver_id=#{userId} and m.msg_target_url=concat('/enterprise/system-events/interviews/',a.apt_id,'/status/',a.apt_status)) order by a.apt_updated_at,a.apt_id limit 50
select msg_target_url as target from t_msg where msg_id=#{messageId} and msg_receiver_id=#{userId}

select a.app_id as applicationId,t.tal_id as candidateId,p.pos_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionTitle,u.nick_name as candidateName from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id=a.app_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=a.app_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where a.app_id=#{id} and p.pos_company_id=#{companyId}

select a.apt_id as appointmentId,t.tal_id as candidateId,p.pos_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionTitle,u.nick_name as candidateName,a.apt_interviewer_id as interviewerId, a.apt_status as status,date_format(a.apt_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startTime, date_format(a.apt_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endTime from t_sch_appointment a join t_pos p on p.pos_id=a.apt_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=a.apt_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where a.apt_id=#{id} and p.pos_company_id=#{companyId}

select e.evl_id as evaluationId,s.ses_id as sessionId,t.tal_id as candidateId, p.pos_id as positionId,p.pos_title as positionTitle,u.nick_name as candidateName, e.evl_overall_score as overallScore,cast(e.evl_dimension_scores as char) as dimensionScores, e.evl_summary as summary,e.evl_advantages as advantages,e.evl_risks as risks, e.evl_gaps as gaps,e.evl_recommendation as recommendation,s.ses_appointment_id as appointmentId, date_format(coalesce(s.ses_start_at,e.evl_created_at),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startedAt from t_int_evaluation e join t_int_session s on s.ses_id=e.evl_session_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id=s.ses_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id=s.ses_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=t.tal_user_id where e.evl_id=#{id} and p.pos_company_id=#{companyId}
